No. The Moon is about **52° below the horizon**, so it is geometrically impossible to see from Perth at that time, regardless of the clear, dark sky.

Its **5.75% illumination** indicates a thin crescent, but it is only **27.7° from the Sun** and is on the same below-horizon side of the sky. You would need to wait until it rises—likely shortly before sunrise—to have any chance of spotting it.
